- **Web app** (this chat): https://127.0.0.1:8443 · CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca — visit from a phone or computer on the same network, take the root certificate on the first visit, and you get chats, files, the screen and voice here.
- I can have my own **Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX** accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own **Messenger and Instagram** — each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR to log me in. Want that?
- I can **register accounts** on websites (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for a hand with captchas or phone checks.
- I can **schedule jobs**, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.
Noted — good to have you set up. I'll use this chat for staff matters. The messaging accounts: not for now, maybe later.

Understood — I'll hold all TA requests until Monday; there's already a 09:00 reminder on Monday 23rd to go through them with you. Messaging accounts: noted, none for now, and I can set them up whenever you change your mind. I'm here in this chat for staff matters.
